$comment: Generic content schema for prose templates (ws6). The supplied facts a document must carry: every value of 80 characters or fewer must appear verbatim in the rendered HTML. Labels and sources are bookkeeping and are not coverage-checked.

summary.$comment: One paragraph in the author's words; long prose is counted, not matched.

value.$comment: Write the value exactly as the document shows it: 99.1%, 410ms, SEV-2.
